entities.summary: Eastern Roman Empire, a political institution in Croatia during Illyrian and Roman Dalmatia (168 BCE–476). Grew from Illyrian and Celtic Tribes. Led to the emergence of Roman Empire and Construction of Diocletian's Palace at Split.
